target_year_over_year_context.explanation:
2025 D031 is a composite disclosure covering three specific aspects of the Mainframe portfolio: Cybersecurity & Compliance Management, Beyond Code Programs, and Foundational Solutions. 2024 D052 (Identity & Access Management/Cybersecurity), D053 (Compliance & Data Protection), and D047 (Beyond Code Programs) map directly to the specific components detailed in D031. D031 explicitly describes managing mainframe access (D052), compliance/protecting data (D053), and Beyond Code programs (D047). This is a valid many-to-one link.

2024 disclosure D054 describes the Security Insights Platform for mainframe security posture. 2025 disclosure D031 describes Cybersecurity & Compliance Management, which explicitly mentions protecting crucial mainframe data, identifying risk, and supporting external security managers, aligning with the mainframe security subject. While the naming changed, the specific subject of mainframe security management is preserved.

previous_disclosures.summary: Beyond Code programs address skills development, staffing, change management, and cost-saving initiatives to help customers maximize mainframe investments and drive business success.
Identity & Access Management solutions manage mainframe access with modern practices like multi-factor authentication and privileged user management, supporting external security managers.
These solutions protect crucial mainframe data to ensure compliance, identify risk, and reduce security management load through automated identification and authorization cleanup.

The Security Insights Platform helps ensure a trusted environment by interpreting mainframe security posture, identifying risks, and developing remediation steps, with data available for in-house security tools.

current_disclosures.summary: Cybersecurity & Compliance Management aligns mainframe platforms with enterprise security mandates and protects crucial data; Beyond Code Programs upskill workforces and improve efficiency; Foundational & Open Mainframe Solutions deliver mission-critical core capabilities and modern, API-driven cloud-integrated tools.

materiality_analysis.reason: The 2025 disclosure consolidates four distinct 2024 mainframe-related product/service descriptions into a single 'Cybersecurity & Compliance Management' and 'Beyond Code' narrative, while introducing a new 'Foundational & Open Mainframe Solutions' category. The addition of 'Foundational & Open Mainframe Solutions' which explicitly mentions 'modern, API-driven, cloud-integrated tools' represents a new strategic offering and expansion of the mainframe portfolio scope not present in 2024. The renaming and merging of cybersecurity components also reflects a strategic shift in how these capabilities are packaged and presented to customers.
